# New renderings, iliad-127 (20.1–102)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἀκερσεκόμης (Φοῖβος, 20.39; ἀ- "not" + κείρω "cut" + κόμη "hair") | "with unshorn hair" | "with unshorn hair" | "unshorn-haired"; "long-haired" (reserved for κάρη κομόωντες / καρηκομόωντες Ἀχαιοί), "golden-haired", "flowing-haired" (each adds a detail the Greek does not give) |
| σῶκος (Ἑρμῆς, 20.72; meaning not known, "strong" or "saving" the ancient guesses) | "sturdy" | "sturdy" (+ note: meaning not known, a guess) | "saving", "strong" (κρατερός / καρτερός), "lucky", "swift" (each picks a guess) |
| ὑπέρθυμος (Πηλεΐων ὑπέρθυμος, 20.88; ὑπέρ "over" + θυμός "heart") | "high-hearted" | "high-hearted" | "overbold", "arrogant", "proud" (each decides blame or praise), "high-spirited" and "stout-hearted" (turned down for μεγάθυμος "great-hearted"); keeps θυμός "heart" |
| ἀπειρεσίη (γαῖαν ἀπειρεσίην, 20.58) | "boundless" | "boundless" | "endless", "limitless", "vast" |
| ἄναξ ἐνέρων (Ἀϊδωνεύς, 20.61; ἔνεροι "those below") | "lord of the dead" | "lord of the dead" | "king of the underworld", "lord of those below"; ἄναξ keeps "lord"; Ἀϊδωνεύς stays transliterated "Aidoneus" (5.190) |
| ἐναντίον (Ἀχιλῆος ἐναντίον … μάχεσθαι, 20.97) | "against" (the line: "it is not possible against Achilles for a man to fight") | "against" | "face to face" (reserved for ἀντίον), "in opposition" (reserved for ἀντιβίην), "opposite" (kept for ἄντα / ἔναντα); ἀντία is "against" too, the context deciding |
| κύδανον (20.42, κυδάνω) | "exulted" | "exulted" | "were glorified", "rejoiced"; follows the table’s ὑπερκύδαντας "the exulting Achaeans" |
| νηκούστησε (20.14, νη- + ἀκούω) | "was deaf to" | "did not turn a deaf ear to" | "disobeyed" (kept for ἀπιθέω), "ignored"; the compound is "not hear" |
| τίθει φάος (20.95) | "was setting light" | "set light" (+ note: the figure not explained) | "lit the way", "made the way clear", "gave success" (each decides the figure) |
| ἶσον τείνειεν πολέμου τέλος (20.101) | "stretched equal the end of war" | "stretch the outcome of the war out on equal terms" (+ note: the image not explained) | "balanced the scales" (brings in scales, which the verb does not), "made the fight even" |
| ἀγῶνα νεῶν (μετ’ ἀγῶνα νεῶν, 20.33) | "the gathering of the ships" | "the gathering of the ships" | "assembly" (reserved for ἀγορή), "contest", "the Achaean camp" (supplies what the Greek leaves out) |
